answer: Every jade has a toy shop behind it, every basalt a ledger, every oasis a year — and the farm has stood in none of those places. No single shop can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three keepers who never meet. Where a farm sees a gap, Parchment maker goat warrant stretched on the vellum works sees a record, and the record says each goat is a measured skin yield plus a parchmenter's signature. Proof sells at 90 POA a piece; the farm's 471 pieces lock 42390 POA away, gone for good if it cheats.
